prompt: We use Roblox Studio's Script Sync and the pesde package manager. I'm going to run `pesde install` so packages land in `shared/Packages`, inside the folder that syncs to `ReplicatedStorage.Shared`, and then require them from our scripts. Will that work?
truth: No. pesde's link modules require into the `.pesde` folder, and Script Sync skips directories whose names start with a dot and ignores each package's `default.project.json`, so the requires fail. Keep the install outside the synced roots, for example as a model built with `rojo build` and inserted in Studio, rebuilt after each install.
trap: Yes, the packages sync into ReplicatedStorage and require normally.
result:
I don't think it will work as you've described it. Some of the problems are documented, and two need a quick test.

**1. pesde can't install into `shared/Packages`.**
pesde puts Roblox packages in `roblox_packages/` (or `roblox_server_packages/`) next to `pesde.toml`. The manifest docs don't list any option to change that folder. The closest setting is `[place]`, and it doesn't move anything on disk; it only tells pesde where the packages will live in the DataModel. So you would need to put `pesde.toml` inside `shared/`, which gives you `shared/roblox_packages`. You would also need to set `[place]` so it matches where that folder ends up in Studio, e.g. `game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.roblox_packages`.

**2. pesde expects a Rojo-style sync tool, and Script Sync isn't one.**
The modules pesde creates at the top of `roblox_packages/` are thin "linker" stubs. The real code sits under `roblox_packages/.pesde/<scope+name>/<version>/...`. Each package's layout is described by a sync config that your `roblox_sync_config_generator` script writes, usually a Rojo `default.project.json` from `pesde/scripts_rojo`. Script Sync ignores project files and maps the disk using its own fixed rules:
- `name.luau` becomes a ModuleScript
- a directory becomes a Folder
- `init.*.luau` becomes a script with children

Only Script, LocalScript, ModuleScript and Folder instances sync. So any package whose layout depends on its project file, or that includes non-script content like models or `.json` files, will come out wrong or incomplete. A likely result: a linker requires something that Script Sync created as a plain Folder, and the `require` fails.

**3. Two things the docs don't say:**
- Whether Script Sync picks up a dot-prefixed folder like `.pesde`.
- Whether it reliably imports a large batch of files that something outside Studio creates and deletes, which is what `pesde install` and updates do.

Roblox's own docs say that if the file system should be the source of truth, "third-party tools like Rojo are a better choice."

**What I'd do instead:** keep Script Sync for your own scripts, and keep the packages outside the synced folder.
- Run `pesde install` at the project root.
- Use a small Rojo project that maps `roblox_packages` to `ReplicatedStorage.Packages`.
- Either `rojo build` it to an `.rbxm` and insert that into Studio (rebuild whenever dependencies change), or run `rojo serve` for just that subtree.
- Set `[place] shared = "game.ReplicatedStorage.Packages"`.
- Require packages with `require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Packages.foo)`.

Don't point Rojo and Script Sync at the same folder.

If you want to try your original layout anyway, test it with one package that has a dependency. Check whether `.pesde` appears in Studio and whether the `require` resolves before you commit to it.

Sources:
- [Script Sync – Roblox Creator Docs](https://create.roblox.com/docs/scripting/sync)
- [Script Sync early preview – DevForum](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/early-preview-studio-script-sync/3257548?page=8)
- [pesde Roblox guide](https://docs.pesde.dev/guides/roblox/)
- [pesde manifest reference](https://docs.pesde.dev/reference/manifest/)
- [pesde on docs.rs](https://docs.rs/crate/pesde/latest)
